intro: Seventeen high-severity articles tagged apt appeared between 13 April and 16 September 2026. GopherWhisper, CHOSEN BRICK, and CyberAv3ngers are the most-covered threat actors in this archive. Reporting spans government, energy, cryptocurrency, technology, and aviation, with activity tracked across Global, Japan, Mongolia, the United kingdom, and the United states. Every item in the tag carries a high severity rating, reflecting sustained coverage of advanced persistent threat operations throughout the period.
